title: Nutraceutical Evaluation of Trigonelline's Therapeutic Potential by Targeting Bladder Cancer Stem Cells and Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts via Downregulation of TGFbeta3/GLI2/YAP1 Signaling Hub.
authors: Kao, Chien-Chang; Shih, Jing-Wen; Huynh, Huong Thi Luu Kim; Chang, Ching-Hsin; Lawal, Bashir; Iamsaard, Sitthichai; Azizah, Nur; Ritmaleni, Ritmaleni; Lin, Justin Kung-Yi; Huang, Po-Yang; Wu, Alexander T H; Liu, Ming-Che
one_liner_zh: 该文研究葫芦巴碱通过下调TGFbeta3/GLI2/YAP1信号轴靶向膀胱癌干细胞和肿瘤微环境，虽含分子对接但对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法以实验为主，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Trigonelline (TGN), an alkaloid identified in medicinal plants such as coffee (Coffea spp.) and fenugreek (Trigonella foenum-graecum), has demonstrated significant anticancer properties across various malignancies, yet its efficacy in bladder cancer (BLCA) remains underappreciated. This study investigates TGN's role in modulating cancer stem cells (CSCs) and the tumor microenvironment (TME), two key contributors to BLCA progression and chemoresistance. Through comprehensive bioinformatics analyses of BLCA patient datasets, a TGY signature (TGFbeta3, GLI2, YAP1) was identified as a critical signaling hub associated with poor prognosis, therapeutic resistance, and CSC generation. Computational docking studies revealed TGN's high binding affinity to the TGY signature, TGFbeta3 (DeltaG = -3.9 kcal/mol), GLI2 (DeltaG = -4.2 kcal/mol), YAP1 (DeltaG = -3.4 kcal/mol), suggesting its potential to disrupt this signaling axis. In vitro experiments demonstrated that TGN effectively inhibited BLCA cell proliferation, colony formation, and tumorspheroid growth while significantly enhancing cisplatin sensitivity in resistant cell lines. Notably, TGN reduced the transformation of fibroblasts into cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs) through the downregulation of alpha-SMA and FAP (Fibroblast activation protein) expression, indicating its capacity to normalize the TME. Real-time PCR analysis revealed that TGN treatment significantly reduced markers of epithelial-mesenchymal transition and stemness pathways. Our preclinical mouse study demonstrated that combining TGN and cisplatin significantly reduced tumorigenesis in cisplatin-resistant bladder tumoroids harboring CAFs. Importantly, this combination therapy showed no apparent systematic toxicity, suggesting a favorable safety profile. Our findings reveal novel molecular targets of TGN in bladder cancer; TGN acts as a potent disruptor of the TGY signaling axis and a normalizer of the TME by reducing CAF transformation. In sum, our findings advocate for TGN's further exploration as a candidate for combination therapy in drug-resistant BLCA, with the potential to improve patient outcomes by simultaneously targeting both CSCs and the TME, serving as a foundation for future clinical trials.
abstract_zh: 葫芦巴碱（TGN），一种在咖啡（Coffea spp.）和葫芦巴（Trigonella foenum-graecum）等药用植物中鉴定出的生物碱，已在多种恶性肿瘤中显示出显著的抗癌特性，但其在膀胱癌（BLCA）中的疗效仍未得到充分认识。本研究探讨了TGN在调节癌症干细胞（CSCs）和肿瘤微环境（TME）中的作用，这两者是BLCA进展和化疗耐药的关键促成因素。通过对BLCA患者数据集的全面生物信息学分析，鉴定出TGY特征（TGFbeta3、GLI2、YAP1）作为与不良预后、治疗耐药和CSC生成相关的关键信号枢纽。计算对接研究显示，TGN与TGY特征具有高结合亲和力，TGFbeta3（DeltaG = -3.9 kcal/mol）、GLI2（DeltaG = -4.2 kcal/mol）、YAP1（DeltaG = -3.4 kcal/mol），表明其具有破坏该信号轴的潜力。体外实验表明，TGN有效抑制BLCA细胞增殖、集落形成和肿瘤球生长，同时显著增强耐药细胞系对顺铂的敏感性。值得注意的是，TGN通过下调alpha-SMA和FAP（成纤维细胞活化蛋白）表达，减少了成纤维细胞向癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）的转化，表明其具有正常化TME的能力。实时PCR分析显示，TGN处理显著降低了上皮-间质转化和干性通路标志物的表达。我们的临床前小鼠研究表明，TGN与顺铂联合使用显著减少了携带CAFs的顺铂耐药膀胱肿瘤类器官中的肿瘤发生。重要的是，这种联合治疗未表现出明显的系统性毒性，提示其具有良好的安全性特征。我们的发现揭示了TGN在膀胱癌中的新型分子靶点；TGN作为TGY信号轴的强效破坏因子和通过减少CAF转化来正常化TME的调节因子。总之，我们的研究结果支持进一步探索TGN作为耐药BLCA联合治疗候选药物的可能性，其通过同时靶向CSCs和TME有望改善患者预后，为未来临床试验奠定基础。
